description: This file defines a data class, LoanSchedulePlanDownPaymentPeriod, which implements the LoanSchedulePlanPeriod interface. It models a period of a loan schedule with details such as period number, start and due dates, and various amount-related fields.

classes.name: LoanSchedulePlanDownPaymentPeriod
classes.description: Immutable data class representing a specific down payment period within a loan schedule, including period dates and financial amounts.

methods.name: periodFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the period.

methods.name: periodDueDate
methods.description: Returns the due date of the period.
